subject.title: fix: prevent TUI PTY tests from aborting after completion

question: Should the repository accept awaited, bounded PTY teardown as the canonical TUI test-harness lifecycle for the pinned native node-pty runtime?
rationale: The patch is narrowly scoped and proof-positive, but it changes lifecycle ordering around native callbacks and carries the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Accept the lifecycle contract
options.body: Approve the awaited, idempotent cleanup path after confirming the timeout and listener-release ordering match intended TUI harness ownership.

options.title: Request an alternative teardown design
options.body: Keep the PR open only if maintainers prefer a different native PTY ownership or worker-shutdown contract.
